rationale: LAB-06 upheld ADR 0014: the pack depends on a climate ABSTRACTION, not a specific seasons mod. No candidate was added to pack/ directly or indirectly. Homeostatic Seasons is the best 26.2 provider candidate because it boots beside Matcha and leaves the recipe and advancement baseline unchanged.
companion_role: Climate abstraction so pack systems do not hardcode one season mod.
custom_justification: The abstraction is justified; the simulation is not.
notes: LAB-06: PILOT behind the abstraction only. Serene Seasons DEFER (beta, All Rights Reserved, beta GlitchCore dep). Removal is NOT a cosmetic toggle: a provider game rule can survive as an unknown registry key after the jar is removed.

rationale: LAB-06 confirmed the abstraction must expose calendar, transition, weather and temperature. Homeostatic supplies all four, which is what makes it the pilot target.
existing_mod_candidate: adapter over the selected climate provider
companion_role: Adapter over the selected climate mod.
custom_justification: No mod can know what this pack wants to do with weather state.
notes: LAB-06: crop suitability, unknown-crop handling, greenhouse mitigation and the client projection still need a focused ticket before adoption.

rationale: LAB-07 tested seven storage mods and found NONE that indexes arbitrary registered containers server-authoritatively without wireless access or data loss on removal. The prototype code previously classified REPLACE is therefore retained as ADAPT.

custom_justification: Not applicable.

Ductwork REJECTED only for lacking a visible item renderer. Provider, requester, autocrafting, permissions and graph bounds remain unproven for the pilot.
